description: A capability your application executes on the model's behalf: the model proposes a call with arguments, your code runs it and returns the result as context.
Everything around the model: tools, permissions, sandboxes, hooks, verification and context files.
Model Context Protocol: an open standard so any AI application can use tools, resources and prompts exposed by any server.
Agent2Agent protocol: an open standard for delegating tasks to other agents, which may be long-running and opaque.
Packaged instructions and scripts an agent loads only when a task needs them.
This module's checkpoint: the integration mechanism per system, the tool catalog and the loading strategy for a product.
